reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the finding correctly proposes no redline and no counterparty comment, consistent with playbook treatment of fallback-level clauses.

The cited text (p0841) supports the classification on every material fallback term: it is mutual ('neither Party'), limited to employees 'involved in the performance or oversight of any of the development activities hereunder' rather than all personnel, prohibits solicitation only (no no-hire language), and contains an express general-advertising carve-out ('general solicitation for employment placed in a trade journal, newspaper or website').

The failed deterministic duration check is explained by the [***] redaction rather than an excessive term; the rationale transparently notes this and correctly flags that a tail exceeding 24 months would be a separate walk-away issue to confirm on the unredacted copy.

Shortfalls versus the preferred position (tail measured from expiry of the Term rather than end of involvement; no separate unsolicited-approach carve-out) are properly recorded in the rationale as minor sub-elements rather than escalated to a deviation, matching the playbook's classification semantics; redlining an acceptable fallback would be over-flagging.
